clock: Working days after explicit implementation resume; includes review and mandatory verification. Targets, not guarantees.

phases.title: Runnable primitive MVP
phases.scope: One local SDF world, Rapier f64 box/sphere dynamics and static box ground; live gzweb-rs scene and poses; pause, resume and reset.
phases.acceptance: On a clean supported Linux setup, documented launch commands start the Rapier-only runtime and gzweb-rs. The real browser shows at least 20 moving primitive bodies and correct transforms; pause/resume/reset, reconnect and clean shutdown work. No C++ engine or GPU is required by the server.
phases.excluded: Mesh assets/collisions, joints, sensors, remote Fuel and full Gazebo compatibility.

phases.title: Local mesh visualization
phases.scope: Render local glTF 2.0 mesh visuals in gzweb-rs; keep primitive collisions.
phases.acceptance: A moving body with a local mesh visual has correct scale, orientation and resource paths in the actual browser; missing or invalid assets fail clearly.
phases.excluded: Mesh collisions, texture conversion, remote downloads and general asset formats.

phases.title: Mesh collisions
phases.scope: Rapier static triangle-mesh and dynamic convex-hull collision from the admitted local mesh input.
phases.acceptance: Static mesh contact and one dynamic convex hull pass geometry/contact and reset tests; unsupported nonconvex dynamic input is explicitly rejected.
phases.excluded: Automatic convex decomposition, deformables, heightmaps and arbitrary mesh formats.

phases.title: IMU sensor model
phases.scope: Wire the existing IMU model through loaded SDF demand and the live Rapier world; expose its canonical messages.
phases.acceptance: One configured IMU publishes correct units, frame, sample count and timestamps; pause/reset and last-consumer teardown pass. A no-IMU world owns no IMU callbacks or buffers.
phases.excluded: Other sensor families and full noise-model parity.

phases.title: RGB camera model
phases.scope: Activate one SDF RGB camera using existing offscreen Bevy rendering and bounded image delivery.
phases.acceptance: A known primitive scene produces real timestamped images at the requested rate; frame, pause/reset, removal and overload controls pass.
phases.excluded: Camera arrays, distortion, thermal and segmentation.

phases.title: Depth camera model
phases.scope: Connect the existing metric-depth renderer to one loaded SDF camera and a bounded consumer stream.
phases.acceptance: A calibrated primitive scene yields metric depths and documented background/clipping behavior; reset epochs, removal and bounded delivery pass.
phases.excluded: RGB-D registration, point clouds and depth noise parity.

phases.title: CPU ray lidar model
phases.scope: One planar ray lidar using Rapier queries against admitted primitive and mesh collisions.
phases.acceptance: Analytic range fixtures, min/max range, frame, acquisition timestamps and pause/reset pass; visualization can inspect the scan.
phases.excluded: GPU lidar, intensities, multi-layer scans and all lidar variants.

phases.title: Differential-drive system
phases.scope: One two-wheel Rapier robot, velocity command and odometry, visible in gzweb-rs.
phases.acceptance: A simple robot drives and turns from real commands; wheel limits, odometry frames, pause/reset and absent-system teardown pass.
phases.excluded: Ackermann, tracked vehicles and general drivetrain parity.

phases.title: Joint controller systems
phases.scope: One admitted Rapier revolute chain with position and velocity controllers.
phases.acceptance: Commands move the displayed joints with documented limits and stable IDs; bad commands, reset and removal pass.
phases.excluded: General articulations, mimic/transmission semantics and all controller families.

phases.title: Interactive world lifecycle
phases.scope: Expose focused spawn/remove and entity-state operations to the live browser for the admitted MVP scene.
phases.acceptance: Spawn and remove primitives and one local mesh without stale IDs or visuals; rejected requests are atomic; reconnect obtains a current snapshot.
phases.excluded: Multiworld, levels and distributed stepping.

phases.title: Focused recording and replay
phases.scope: Record and replay the admitted scene, poses and controls for one local session.
phases.acceptance: A short recorded session reproduces its timestamps and entity lifecycle in gzweb-rs; malformed input and bounded buffering pass.
phases.excluded: Compatibility with every historical Gazebo log format and full sensor recording.

phases.title: Installable integrated preview
phases.scope: Package the accepted subset and document supported capabilities, setup and a runnable robot demo.
phases.acceptance: A clean-machine installation runs the integrated demo; required coverage, CI, licenses and retained regressions pass at the release commit, with a published limitations matrix.
phases.excluded: Full rewrite completion and unsupported platforms/backends/features.

phases.title: Ideal altimeter
phases.scope: One loaded-world, noise-free Rapier altimeter using existing SDF cadence and canonical upstream Zenoh publication.
phases.acceptance: Actual native comparison and canonical wire delivery establish sensor-point world-Z position/reference/velocity, frame/time/cadence, demand, pause, loaded reset, removal and stale-generation fences. No sensor means no callbacks or transport declarations. All mandatory gates and independent review pass at the promoted candidate.
phases.excluded: Noise, runtime sensor spawning, rate-control services, additional sensor families, backend parity expansion and native rewind-parity claims.

phases.title: Local STL meshes
phases.scope: Bounded local ASCII/binary STL import, immutable generated GLB visuals in the accepted viewer and unchanged Rapier static/closed-convex collision admission.
phases.acceptance: Malformed and excessive input fails atomically; geometry/basis/scale/contact and lifecycle controls pass, actual served geometry is immutable, and the real browser displays and controls an asymmetric STL scene. All mandatory gates and independent review pass at the promoted candidate.
phases.excluded: Mesh repair/decomposition, colors/materials/attributes, remote loading, broad asset-format parity, new viewer/protocol/framework or backend capabilities.

phases.title: Ideal air pressure
phases.scope: One loaded-world, noise-free Rapier air-pressure sensor using the pinned native geopotential model, fixed SDF cadence and canonical upstream Zenoh FluidPressure publication.
phases.acceptance: Actual native/model and real canonical wire controls establish absolute sensor world-Z pressure, units/frame/time/sequence, demand/cadence/pause/loaded reset/removal and stale-generation/atomic-refusal behavior; no sensor means no callbacks or declarations. All mandatory gates and independent review pass before qualified Main acceptance.
phases.excluded: Noise, nonzero reference altitude, explicit/nondefault atmosphere, runtime sensor spawning or rate/reference services, new UI, new transport/framework, environmental layers and broader backend/native rewind parity.

phases.title: Local OBJ meshes
phases.scope: Bounded local triangle-only OBJ import using maintained tobj, immutable generated GLB visuals in the accepted viewer and existing Rapier static/closed-convex collision admission.
phases.acceptance: Malformed/excessive/unsupported/external-resource input refuses atomically; indices, geometry/basis/scale/contact and lifecycle controls pass; served generated geometry stays immutable; actual browser robot controls show an asymmetric OBJ scene. All mandatory gates and independent review pass before qualified Main acceptance.
phases.excluded: Arbitrary polygon triangulation, materials/textures/colors, mesh repair/decomposition, remote loading, new viewer/protocol/framework and additional backend capability.

phases.acceptance: Actual pinned native model and moving-pose observations, all emitted field/frame/time/sequence values, canonical wire, cadence/demand/pause/reset/removal and atomic-refusal/stale-generation controls pass; all mandatory gates and independent audits precede qualified Main promotion.

later_work: Continue directly to the next useful named increment after accepting a phase while retained work remains. Each is bounded to at most five working days including independent review and mandatory checks. Independent increments may share a parallel source wave with one integrator. Full rewrite compatibility remains separate from accepted phase counts.
